answer.reason: Samson's life is told at length in Judges, so three or four chief events can be named, each resting on narrow verses.

clauses.english: killed a thousand Philistines with a donkey's jawbone
clauses.quote: and slew a thousand men therewith

clauses.english: lost his strength when Delilah had his hair shaved, and was blinded and imprisoned by the Philistines
clauses.quote: the Philistines took him, and put out his eyes

clauses.english: pulled down the house of Dagon on the Philistines and died with them
clauses.quote: the house fell upon the lords, and upon all the people that were therein

doubts: JDG 14:5-6 (lion) and JDG 15:4-5 (foxes) left out to keep the line short.
The dataset's judging years are only the summary's office, so not used.
HEB 11:32 only lists his name, so not cited.
